lead.headline: McLaurin sat Friday — a rest day — and a better cover just became free
lead.deck: Washington call it maintenance; Saturday's report still decides. Allgeier starts for Arizona and costs you only the idle Vikings defence.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Terry McLaurin did not practise on Friday after a limited Thursday. Washington describe it as a veteran rest day, not a setback with the hamstring, and his designation comes on Saturday. He plays Monday night; your bench locks on Sunday. Alvin Kamara, the only cover on the roster, was limited all week with his back. On Friday Arizona ruled out Jeremiyah Love, which makes Tyler Allgeier their starter — and he is a free agent. Add him for the Vikings defence, on bye, and McLaurin's cover improves and locks three hours later. Otherwise the lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.0 against Bok-aneers' 112.5; ESPN gives you 57%.
